name: LastBuyerWins
mechanic: Every big enough buy resets a 1 hour clock. When it hits zero, the last buyer takes 80% of the pot.
plain: A countdown game for ETH pools. Every trade pays 0.2% of its ETH side into the pool's pot. A buy above the current minimum makes you the last buyer and resets a 1 hour clock. If nobody buys before the clock runs out, you win 80% of the pot and the other 20% starts the next round. The minimum buy rises with the pot (1% of it), so a big pot cannot be sniped with dust. Winnings are claimed, never pushed.
rules: Every swap pays 0.2% of its ETH side into the pool's pot.
A buy of at least max(MIN_BUY, 1% of the pot) becomes the last buyer and resets the 1 hour clock.
When the clock runs out, the last buyer can claim 80% of the pot; the rest seeds the next round.
Settlement happens on the next swap or when anyone calls settle(); payouts are pull-only via claim().

fee.note: 0.2% of the ETH side into the pot
